messages:
emma.support: FYI, MedicalLoop (acct: ML-582) opened an urgent ticket requesting escalation under their BAA. They say audit logs for PHI-access events are missing for the window 2026-03-15 01:00-03:00 UTC. Also seeing KMS/HSM errors during key rotation attempts. Need triage.
ryan.eng: Thanks — can you paste the errors they reported + any request IDs? Also which deployment mode (private VPC or Dedicated)?
medicalloop-sre: Private deployment (on-prem package). We attempted key rotation for the customer-managed KMS key yesterday. Errors in our sidecar showed 502/timeout talking to HSM, then audit_writer returned permission denied. Repro steps attached below.
emma.support: Copying paste from their ticket:

```
Request ID: req_0a3f9e2c
Time: 2026-03-15T01:42:10Z
API: POST /v1/audit/logs
Payload: {"user":"svc-ingest","action":"read","resource":"patient:1234"}
Response: 500 Internal Server Error
Error: audit_log_write_failed: permission denied

During KMS rotation:
Error: KMS_ERROR: HSM_UNAVAILABLE (code 503)
Detail: tcp: connection reset by peer
```

They also included a curl repro hitting the private control plane:

```
curl -i -X POST 'https://private-control.medicalloop.internal/v1/kms/rotate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -d '{"key_id":"ml-key-01"}'

HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"HSM_UNAVAILABLE","message":"unable to reach HSM endpoint"}
```

They claimed some audit records showed up later in bulk but several dozen events are missing. Need to confirm retention guarantees for BAA and whether we can reconstruct missing audit lines.

ryan.eng: Ok. First things first: can we confirm whether the audit writer retries to disk or to a durable queue when HSM/KMS ops fail? @olivia.secops do you know if private deployments have local durable audit queue enabled by default?

olivia.secops: For private deployments, audit logging writes primarily to the local audit_sink process and also streams to the control plane if connectivity exists. There is a configurable write-buffer on disk (default 10000 events) but older versions (<=v1.6.2) had a bug where audit_sink could drop events on HSM timeouts during rotation. Which version is MedicalLoop running?

medicalloop-sre: Running v1.6.1 (we're a slower updater for cert reasons). We see audit_sink logs with these lines:

```
2026-03-15T01:41:59Z audit_sink WARN write_batch failed: write error: permission denied
2026-03-15T01:42:00Z kms-client ERR rotation failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
2026-03-15T01:42:05Z audit_sink INFO dropped_events_count=28
```

james.account: MedicalLoop is in a BAA addendum with retention 7 years; they flagged this as a compliance incident. We're going to need a formal incident summary for their compliance officer. Support, please set expectation: root cause may be version bug, and we'll propose immediate mitigations.

emma.support: Noted. Proposed immediate mitigations to offer to customer:
- Temporarily roll back the scheduled rotation until HSM is stable
- Enable a hotfix (v1.6.3) that fixes audit_sink drop-on-hsm-timeout
- Provide an event reconstruction report from control plane logs + disk-backed batches
- Offer to run a CRR (consistency/replay) to try to surface missing events

ryan.eng: I can prepare a hotfix build and a deterministic repro. For the reconstruction: if we have the local disk batches preserved we can replay into the audit index. medicalloop-sre, can you confirm whether /var/lib/redwood/audit/batches still contains files from 2026-03-15? If so, tar them and share via S3 link to our secure bucket.

medicalloop-sre: Confirmed. There are files named batch-20260315-01-*.bin. I'll tar them now. ETA 20m.

deploy-bot: @ryan.eng scheduled a canary deploy of redwood-audit v1.6.3-hotfix to private channels ML-582 at 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z. Monitor logs: https://deploys.internal/ML-582/1234

olivia.secops: Also advise customer to rotate the HSM management IP onto the standby HSM node if they have HA. If HSM is flaky, rotations will repeatedly fail and cause backpressure. We'll need HSM vendor logs too.

james.account: I'll draft an incident notification for the MedicalLoop compliance team with next steps + timeline. Support: please include the customer-facing explanation that we have identified a bug in v1.6.1 that can drop audit events during HSM outages, and steps we're taking to restore lost data and prevent recurrence.

emma.support: Patch notes and customer email draft ready. MedicalLoop has requested an ATO-level statement; I'll include:
- timeline of events
- whether we can guarantee reconstitution of missing events (we can attempt reconstruction but cannot assert 100% until we replay batches)
- offer to sign an engineering attestation after replay

ryan.eng: Action items for us:
- [ryan.eng] build + validate v1.6.3-hotfix (CI+canary) — ETA 2h
- [medicalloop-sre] upload audit batch tarball to secure bucket — ETA 20m
- [olivia.secops] coordinate with HSM vendor and review HSM logs — ETA 4h
- [james.account] send compliance notification & next steps — ETA 1h

medicalloop-sre: Uploaded tarball: s3://redwood-secure/ml-582/audit-batches/20260315-01.tar.gz (shared link provided to ops team)

emma.support: Thanks everyone. I'm keeping the severity P1 for compliance. Will update ticket with canary link and incident doc. :thumbsup:

olivia.secops: If replay finds gaps we should consider offering extended retention export at our cost so they can provide to auditors.

ryan.eng: I'll start the build now and run the audit replay tool locally against the uploaded batches. Will post logs in this thread.

medicalloop-sre: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Customer is on standby for the incident summary.
